test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 18 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: Find the volume (in cm³, rounded off to 2 decimal places) of a right circular cone of diameter 12 cm and height 5 cm. [Use pi=(22)/(7)]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Radius (r) = Diameter ÷ 2 = 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm.

Volume of Cone = (1/3) × π × r² × h

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × 6² × 5

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × 12 × 5 = 1320 ÷ 7

⇒ Volume = 188.5714... ≈ 188.57 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 188.57 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter of the base (d) = 12 cm

Height of the cone (h) = 5 cm

Value of π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Radius (r) = d ÷ 2

Volume of a right circular cone = (1/3) × π × r² × h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5e25deae9c66857d19a11e53b2edbf17cdb2b84891e511457f707441d0a2ad3.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Radius (r) = 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × (6)² × 5

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × 36 × 5

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × 12 × 5

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × 60

⇒ Volume = 1320 ÷ 7

⇒ Volume = 188.5714... cm³

⇒ Rounding off to 2 decimal places, Volume ≈ 188.57 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 188.57 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Slant Height of a Cone

The slant height (l) is calculated using Pythagoras theorem: l = √(r² + h²).

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The area of the curved surface of a cone is given by: CSA = π × r × l.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The sum of the curved surface area and the base area: TSA = π × r × (r + l).

Volume of a Cylinder

For a given radius and height, the volume of a cylinder is exactly three times the volume of a cone: V = π × r² × h.
